event.title: Asteroid Field
event.text: The cluster is full of tumbling rock. Your pilots weave between the bigger asteroids, but the small ones will keep coming. Shields up.

choice.text: Mine a few for Mawjig while you're here.

outcome.text: The rock is rich. Your converters work through a whole asteroid.
Something else is hiding in the field.

event.title: Rocks and Raiders
event.text: Asteroids fill the cluster, and your sensors pick out a ship hiding among them, engines cold, waiting for someone to come close.

choice.text: It's an ambush. Fight it out among the rocks.

event.title: Too Close to a Star
event.text: The cluster's jump point is far too close to an unstable star. Its flares will lick across your ships while you're here. Fires are likely.

choice.text: Charge the drives and stay alert.

event.title: Fire and Steel
event.text: A flaring star, and a ship using its glare to hide. It comes at you out of the light.

event.title: Nebula
event.text: A thick nebula swallows the cluster. Your sensors are almost blind in here: you won't see inside other ships. Then again, neither will anyone else.

choice.text: Search the nebula for anything useful.

outcome.text: Hidden in the murk is the wreck of a smuggler. Its hold isn't empty.
You aren't the only ones hiding in here.

choice.text: Wait for the drives to charge.

event.title: Ion Storm
event.text: An ion storm is raging through the cluster. Every ship's power is cut in half while it lasts. Reactors flicker, and the AZC strains to run half its usual systems.

event.title: Storm Raiders
event.text: Someone was waiting for you in the ion storm. Their ships are weakened by it too, but they've had time to get used to it.
